evidence: Implemented T-0044 / P1.3.5 diagnostic-only shiki doctor expansion.
Added scripts/shiki_doctor.py with stable DoctorFinding records, JSON report shape, human output, overall status summary, --target, --online, and --strict behavior.

Preserved existing doctor runtime/entrypoint compatibility fields while adding findings for provider config, git, workflows, checks, CODEOWNERS, manifest, runtime registry, validate_shiki contract drift, and optional GitHub online readiness.

Online checks are opt-in with --online and use gh for auth, repository existence/default branch, secret metadata, branch protection, required checks/reviews/code-owner review, and workflow permissions.
Secret diagnostics report only metadata status and do not print secret values.
Added scripts/test_shiki_doctor.sh covering offline fixtures, fake gh online checks, permission-denied handling, strict warning exit, secret redaction, and human remediation output.
Updated scripts/shiki_cli.py, scripts/shiki_installer.py, scripts/test_shiki_module_boundaries.sh, and scripts/validate_shiki.py for doctor module wiring, staging, and validation.
Added docs/agents/shiki-doctor.md and updated decision-control, checklists, runtime-auth-model, runtime-registry, and github-provider-config docs.

Non-goals preserved: P1.3.6 migration framework, P1.4 governance/evidence model redesign, P2 packaging/release/onboarding, provider plugins, Guardian policy, CCA Review Bridge semantics, branch protection policy, CODEOWNERS ownership, P0.4 semantics, and Node workflow changes.
Local verification is recorded in Pull Request #82 evidence.
